scientific_question: Does the frozen Go2 WBC achieve known, task-independent physical intents published through the same SEA reference adapter required by the frozen SLA-PT?

held_fixed.startup: Reuse standing_reach.StateMonitor, original four-foot and no-contact safety. One independent reset per named slot, same archived layout and startup settings, no replacement.
held_fixed.scope: Standing with fixed base reference, original receiver, original scene ABI and original safety gates. Known provider from measured paused TCP, independent of task label or object position.

source_profile.mode: One bound known intent per eligible start, followed by hold until the original 9 s window closes.

scoring.rows: 2 ms source-clock without time-shift fitting; separate raw intent, installed and achieved TCP plus exact occupied reference and source phase.
metrics: world XYZ and SO3 relative shape Q, signed gain
absolute RMS/peak position and rotation error
fraction within 4 mm / 2 degrees of intended world pose
minimum actual clearance and terminal hold
independent stationary negative and opposed CPU controls
scoring.phase: Credit only verified 50 ms source intervals with exact installed endpoints. Signed TCP motion thresholds 1.0 mm and 0.25 deg.
scoring.scope: Full intended trajectory must stay within the original 4 mm / 2 degree tube over the evaluated motion for a positive qualification. Report per-axis shape independently; zero-variation channels have no shape score.

preconditions: Implement and cold-verify owner and independent dynamic scoring against the identical frozen runtime.
Bind the signed scientific allocation to the published candidate and acquire a fresh exclusive lease per card.
Recheck actual binary, scene, open gripper, 2 ms STOP, owner, resource and safety state.
terminal: Stop on unexpected STOP, contact, missed acknowledgement, owner or clock mismatch or any post-STOP installation/integration. Preserve screen, refusal, technical and unstarted denominators.
